title: Delicious Weeknight Pregnancy Menus: 5 Cook-Once Recipes
excerpt: Five flavorful recipes for busy evenings — soup, stir-fry, egg dishes and yogurt parfaits — balanced for protein, fiber and calcium.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating a balanced and nutritious diet is crucial for the health of both mother and baby. However, with a busy schedule, preparing a meal every day can be a challenge. In this article, we will introduce 5 simple and delicious cook-once recipes, helping pregnant women have a nutritious and balanced dinner.

## Nutrient Analysis
The recipes below are designed to provide enough protein, fiber, and calcium, essential nutrients for the health of mother and baby. Additionally, they are chosen to ensure food safety, avoiding foods that can harm the health of pregnant women.

## 5 Cook-Once Recipes
### 1. Chicken and Vegetable Soup
Chicken and vegetable soup is a simple and nutritious meal. To cook, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 2 carrots
- 2 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 2 teaspoons of fish sauce
- 2 teaspoons of oil
- Herbs (onion, cilantro)

Cook the chicken and vegetables in chicken broth, then season with salt, sugar, and fish sauce.

### 2. Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry
Beef and vegetable stir-fry is a great option for dinner. To cook, you need:
- 200g beef
- 1 carrot
- 1 potato
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 2 teaspoons of fish sauce
- 2 teaspoons of oil
- Herbs (onion, cilantro)

Stir-fry the beef and vegetables in oil, then season with salt, sugar, and fish sauce.

### 3. Fried Eggs
Fried eggs are a simple and nutritious meal. To cook, you need:
- 2 eggs
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 1 teaspoon of oil

Heat the oil in a pan, then crack the eggs into the pan and cook until the eggs are cooked.

### 4. Yogurt Parfait
Yogurt parfait is a simple and nutritious meal. To cook, you need:
- 1 cup of yogurt
- 1 cup of fruit (strawberries, bananas)
- 1 tablespoon of granola

Mix the yogurt, fruit, and granola in a bowl, then enjoy.

### 5. Chicken and Vegetable Fried Rice
Chicken and vegetable fried rice is a simple and nutritious meal. To cook, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 2 carrots
- 2 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 2 teaspoons of fish sauce
- 2 teaspoons of oil
- Herbs (onion, cilantro)

Cook the chicken and vegetables in chicken broth, then cook the rice and mix with the chicken and vegetables.

## Practical Tips
- Always choose fresh and clean food.
- Cook food until it is cooked to ensure food safety.
- Avoid eating foods that can harm the health of pregnant women, such as sushi, sashimi, and raw meat.
- Refer to the [meal planner](/blog/pregnancy-meal-planner) for daily meal ideas.

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about your diet, consult your doctor or a nutritionist. They can help you create a personalized meal plan.
